feeds.title: 303 Magazine
feeds.description: 303 Magazine's mission is to showcase Denver's evolving cultural landscape by developing innovative, inclusive, and relevant content that impacts the readers and the community. They strive to foster the next generation of journalists and media-savvy professionals in an inclusive working environment that showcases a diversity of opinions and thoughts.

feeds.title: Sian Lifts Weights Blog
feeds.description: Sian Lifts Weights is the one stop fitness and lifestyle blog written by Sian Ryan. It was inspired by a dramatic weight loss and a drive to not only better her physical health but also turning herself into the strongest version possible.

feeds.title: Greenlove Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Greenlove Wellness provides a fresh take on lifestyle posts, promoting a plant-based healthy lifestyle with a holistic approach to health and wellness. Founded by Lucy Rose in 2017 in Denver, Colorado, amidst lingering taboos, it integrates plant medicine into yoga classes. Lucy's journey with cannabis during college inspired her to advocate for its calming benefits, fostering balance amidst life's hustle.

feeds.title: Denver Life Magazine
feeds.description: Denver Life Magazine is the premier lifestyle publication celebrating life in Denver and the surrounding region. As a trusted resource for an audience of highly educated, affluent residents of the metro area, Denver Life Magazine highlights the very best of the arts, fine dining, fashion, home design, philanthropy, travel, outdoor adventure, and family life.

feeds.title: New Denizen
feeds.description: New Denizen is a food, travel, and lifestyle blog featuring guides and reviews of the best restaurants, food, and fun activities in Denver, CO, and beyond.

feeds.title: Oak + Oats
feeds.description: I'm Elizabeth, a Colorado photographer, and blogger. I'm also a wife, mama, sister, daughter, and friend! Here we look for the remarkable in every day. We love photographing our daily moments, making memories, and sharing our favorite places here in this space.

feeds.title: Denver I Love
feeds.description: Denver I Love was created to help people delve into Denver in a meaningful and insightful way. It's about connecting with the City and its extraordinary people who think outside the box. It highlights places, faces, and things to do in Denver.

feeds.title: Colorado Mountain Mom
feeds.description: Colorado lifestyle site that features family travel, outdoor adventure, camping, hiking, fitness, health & wellness and Disney tips. Follow along for inspiration and tips on your next vacation, getting your family outside to play, and living your best health & wellness lifestyle.

feeds.title: The Denver Ear
feeds.description: Denver lifestyle blog by Mor Zucker features things to do in Denver such as Denver events, restaurants, shopping, nightlife, family and more.

feeds.title: Blue Mountain Belle
feeds.description: The Denver-based travel and lifestyle blog, Blue Mountain Belle chronicles Channing Morris' adventures around Colorado and the world. Born and raised in Atlanta, GA, this southern belle strives to turn every weekend into a vacation.

feeds.title: Denv.Her. Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Alisha Alexandra & welcome to denv.her. - AKA a little slice of my Denver life and an outlet to share fashion, food, lifestyle events & vent sessions.

feeds.title: Colorado Sundays Blog
feeds.description: Discover great adventures and recipes for the outdoors! Colorado Sundays is a weekend lifestyle blog based in Fort Collins, CO.

feeds.title: Home with Holliday
feeds.description: Interior designer, mother of two, frequent party hostess, charity event planner, sharing my passion for easy and affordable, elegant entertaining, home design, holiday decor, DIY projects, and how to recycle, reuse & re-purpose!

feeds.title: Currently Colorado Blog
feeds.description: Follow L.C. Carter's journey as she travels through Colorado and beyond. Musings of an adventurer and influencer in the outdoors and with brands. Lauren, of Currently Colorado, is a strategic PR planner at heart. She's in the business of making impactful campaigns work for incredible brands.

feeds.title: Lifestyle Denver Blog
feeds.description: Libby Levinson-Katz posts regular updates covering your favorite topics such as Denver Design Trends, Denver Real Estate, Life in Denver, and Neighborhood Spotlights.

feeds.title: Kristiina Craven
feeds.description: Life coach for people pleasers who want to create incredible relationships with confidence and ease. Never dread a family dinner or conversation again!
